name: FA_BOOK_TRANSFERS_OPTIONS
description: This table stores transfer transaction detail data of the source and destination asset book and transfer policies.

columns.name: TRANSFER_OPTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the transfer options used in the transaction.

columns.name: TRX_REFERENCE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the transaction reference which links transactions involving multiple assets.

columns.name: BOOK_TRANSFER_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Book transfer method type identifier.

columns.name: COST_BASIS_CODE
columns.description: Cost basis at which the asset is transferred to the destination book.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATE_ENTERED
columns.description: Date on which the transaction occurred.

columns.name: TRANSFER_POLICY_ID
columns.description: Number that identifies transfer policy.

columns.name: CONVERSION_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Conversion rate type used when transferring the asset from the source book to the destination book.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Conversion rate between the source and destination ledger currencies.

columns.name: REPORTING_CUR_RATE_BASIS_CODE
columns.description: Rate basis type of the reporting currency.

columns.name: CREATE_NEW_ASSET_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the destination asset number is the same as the source.

columns.name: USE_DEST_CAT_DEPRN_RULES_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to use the depreciation rules from the destination category.

columns.name: USE_XFR_DATE_AS_DPIS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to use the date placed in service as the transfer date.

columns.name: COPY_SOURCE_LINES_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to copy the source lines of the source asset to the destination asset.

columns.name: COPY_DFF_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to copy the asset level descriptive flexfield information to the destination asset.

columns.name: COPY_ASSET_KEY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to copy the asset key to the destination asset.

columns.name: SRC_TRANSFER_AMOUNT
columns.description: Source cost at which the asset is transferred.

columns.name: SRC_FREIGHT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Source freight line cost at which the asset is transferred.

columns.name: SRC_NREC_TAX_AMOUNT
columns.description: Source nonrecoverable tax line cost at which the asset is transferred.

columns.name: SRC_MISC_AMOUNT
columns.description: Source miscellaneous line cost at which the asset is transferred.

columns.name: DEST_TRANSFER_AMOUNT
columns.description: Destination cost at which the asset is transferred.

columns.name: DEST_FREIGHT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Destination freight line cost at which the  asset is transferred.

columns.name: DEST_NREC_TAX_AMOUNT
columns.description: Destination nonrecoverable tax line cost at which the asset is transferred.

columns.name: DEST_MISC_AMOUNT
columns.description: Destination miscellaneous line cost at which the asset is transferred.

columns.name: DEPRN_EXPENSE_MAPPING_CODE
columns.description: Depreciation expense account mapping method code.

columns.name: COA_MAPPING_ID
columns.description: Chart of accounts mapping identifier.

columns.name: RETIREMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Retirement type. Use the Manage Fixed Assets Lookups, lookup type FA_RETIREMENT_TYPES to identify valid values.

columns.name: COST_OF_REMOVAL
columns.description: Removal cost. Enter without thousands separator. Use either comma or period as decimal separator. Cannot be negative.

columns.name: RETIREMENT_CONVENTION_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Retirement convention type identifier.

columns.name: NBV_MARKUP_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: Markup percentage on the net book value to transfer the asset to destination book.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
